# cache/simple-cache-bridge

> 标签: Bridge, cache, psr-16, psr-6

## 简介

A PSR-6 bridge to PSR-16. This will make any PSR-6 cache compatible with SimpleCache.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://www.php-cache.com/en/latest/
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/php-cache/simple-cache-bridge.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/cache%2Fsimple-cache-bridge
